name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Technical B2B Sales Professional
summary: B2B sales professional with 15+ years of full-cycle selling and technical solution scoping across SaaS, MarTech, and operations. As co-owner of a licensed cannabis cultivation facility, personally specified and selected HVAC and ventilation equipment, exhaust and intake fans, ducting, climate control, and CO2 systems, working directly with equipment vendors to evaluate options and make buying decisions. Brings that same buyer-side technical fluency into a tenured B2B sales career: ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps, consistently performed above commission floor into accelerator tiers, and is proficient across four CRM platforms.

bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery to surface client goals and close on scope.
Run full-cycle sales and delivery independently as founder, from initial outreach through close and ongoing account expansion.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Personally sold and closed 2 client accounts using programmatic advertising, each at ~$30K MRR (~$360K annualized contract value), owning the client relationship and strategy while a specialist team executed the buys.
Advised client businesses on ad-spend budget planning and allocation across paid campaigns.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15–20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K–$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing automation tools.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K) — roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

Consistently performed above commission floor into accelerator ("doubling") tiers, averaging ~$17,750/month in implementation/services bookings (~$213K annualized).
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
